notices.title: Commissioning of the Library Multimedia Studio at the Main Library
notices.summary: State-of-the-art acoustic podcasting and video recording studio suite launched on 19th January 2026 on the 3rd Floor of the Main Library. Equipped with broadcast studio boom microphones, acoustic timber soundproofing, and overhead studio lighting for scholarly podcasts, lectures, and academic production.

notices.title: Transformation of the Library Learning Commons: Connected Workstations & Digital Hub
notices.summary: Collaborative research workstations, high-speed institutional e-resource terminals, and on-site information desk guidance for interdisciplinary scholarly investigations.

notices.title: Content Registration of Digital Object Identifiers (DOIs) on Crossref
notices.summary: Full integration with Crossref DOI registry, connecting University of Lagos journals, conference proceedings, and faculty monographs directly to the global research citation index.

notices.title: Library Makerspace: 'Make Ideas Happen' Ideation Lounge & Smart Displays
notices.summary: Interactive smart displays, design-thinking whiteboards, and comfortable circular collaboration pods designed to foster student innovation and interdisciplinary creative projects.
